admin.hook_appeals.already_decided.defaultMessage: Eine andere Moderatorin oder ein anderer Moderator hat über diesen Einspruch bereits entschieden. Die Entscheidung gilt.
admin.hook_appeals.already_decided.description: Status message when another moderator decided the appeal of a refused post first.

admin.hook_appeals.cancel.description: Button of the confirmation of a decision on an appeal of a refused post: closes it without deciding.

admin.hook_appeals.column.account.description: Column of the list of appeals of refused posts: the account that tried to post and appealed.

admin.hook_appeals.column.state.description: Column of the list of appeals of refused posts: awaiting review, upheld, or overturned.

admin.hook_appeals.comment.description: Term of an appeal of a refused post: what the author added for the moderators.

admin.hook_appeals.confirm_overturn.desc.defaultMessage: Damit wird die Entscheidung aufgehoben und die Prüfung der Beiträge dieses Kontos beendet. Der abgelehnte Beitrag wird nicht wiederhergestellt: Die Person verfasst ihn erneut. Die Entscheidung kann später nicht mehr geändert werden.
admin.hook_appeals.confirm_overturn.desc.description: Description of the confirmation of overturning an appeal of a refused post.

admin.hook_appeals.confirm_overturn.titl.description: Title of the confirmation of overturning an appeal of a refused post, which cancels the automated review's decision.

admin.hook_appeals.confirm_uphold.descri.defaultMessage: Der Beitrag bleibt abgelehnt, und die Beiträge dieses Kontos werden weiterhin wie bisher geprüft. Die Entscheidung kann später nicht mehr geändert werden.
admin.hook_appeals.confirm_uphold.descri.description: Description of the confirmation of upholding an appeal of a refused post.

admin.hook_appeals.confirm_uphold.title.description: Title of the confirmation of upholding an appeal of a refused post, which keeps the automated review's decision.

admin.hook_appeals.decide_failed.defaultMessage: Die Entscheidung konnte nicht gespeichert werden: {reason}
admin.hook_appeals.decide_failed.description: Error in the confirmation when deciding an appeal of a refused post failed. {reason} says why.

admin.hook_appeals.empty.description: Empty list of appeals of refused posts that await a moderator.

admin.hook_appeals.empty_all.description: Empty list of every appeal of a refused post.

admin.hook_appeals.filter.all.description: Option of the select of the appeals of refused posts: every appeal, decided or not.

admin.hook_appeals.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the select that keeps the appeals of refused posts that await review, or shows every one.

admin.hook_appeals.filter.pending.description: Option of the select of the appeals of refused posts: those that await a moderator.

admin.hook_appeals.none.description: Value of the text or comment of an appeal of a refused post that has none.

admin.hook_appeals.overturn.description: Button of a pending appeal of a refused post that opens the confirmation of overturning it, and the confirmation's button that overturns it.

admin.hook_appeals.overturned.defaultMessage: Ablehnung aufgehoben. Die Entscheidung ist zurückgenommen, und die Beiträge dieses Kontos werden nicht mehr geprüft.
admin.hook_appeals.overturned.description: Status message after a moderator overturned an appeal of a refused post.

admin.hook_appeals.state.overturned.description: State of an appeal of a refused post whose decision a moderator cancelled.

admin.hook_appeals.state.pending.description: State of an appeal of a refused post that awaits a moderator.

admin.hook_appeals.state.upheld.description: State of an appeal of a refused post whose decision a moderator kept.

admin.hook_appeals.status_text.description: Term of an appeal of a refused post: the text the author tried to post.

admin.hook_appeals.submitted_at.description: Term of an appeal of a refused post: when the author sent it.

admin.hook_appeals.title.description: Heading of the section of the automated reviews screen with the authors' appeals of posts the review refused, and the caption of its table.

admin.hook_appeals.upheld.defaultMessage: Ablehnung bestätigt. Der Beitrag bleibt abgelehnt.
admin.hook_appeals.upheld.description: Status message after a moderator upheld an appeal of a refused post.

admin.hook_appeals.uphold.description: Button of a pending appeal of a refused post that opens the confirmation of upholding it, and the confirmation's button that upholds it.
